cohort: Newborns admitted to the Neonatology department of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU) who died within 28 days of life (cases) and surviving, healthy discharged newborns (controls) matched for birth weight and gestational age.
finding: Less than four antenatal visits and sepsis were identified as independent risk factors for neonatal death, while Lower Uterine Cesarean Section (LUCS) was found to be protective.
mod_finding: Lower Uterine Cesarean Section (LUCS) was found to be protective against newborn death.
birth_weight: Matched across cases and controls, specific weights not mentioned.
gest_age: Matched across cases and controls, specific gestational ages not mentioned.
